design: 48-world nonlinear additive SCM transfer with unchanged linear-Gaussian Bayesian inference
misspecification: Ground-truth DAG remains in the 29,281 observed-node DAG space, but structural equations mix linear, tanh, and centered-quadratic parent effects. Inference and experiment scoring remain linear-Gaussian.
interpretation: The previously supported width-2 breadth advantage does not transfer as a statistically resolved benefit when the world is nonlinear but the Bayesian inference model remains linear-Gaussian. Both policies degrade sharply and exact MAP recovery falls to 54.2%. Breadth is therefore established only within the correctly specified benchmark family at this stage.
